facts.fact: The course is routed over ground where the Battle of Rhode Island was fought (29 August 1778).
The Lookout, between the 3rd and 4th holes, marks the site of the 1778 battle; the 18th runs along Narragansett Bay on the right.
Opened in 2000 as the Carnegie Abbey Club (Donald Steel); renamed The Aquidneck Club after members bought it.

concepts.name: The 1778 Field Gun
concepts.rationale: A bronze field gun on its oak carriage above a run of Narragansett Bay waves: the battle fought across the course's ground, and the bay along the 18th.
concepts.interpretation: The gun is a generic 18th-century field piece, not a particular gun from the battle.
concepts.strengths: One subject, no badge or background, in the house style; a subject no other course in the game uses. Not the club's own emblem.
concepts.tradeoffs: The wheel's four spokes are only just readable at 1x.
